prompt: A Chinese boy dressed in traditional attire (cross-collar robe with cloud pattern embroidery), poised atop the majestic Black Tortoise (Xuanwu) of winter. Set against a backdrop of icy indigo and silver-white wintry sky. The Tortoise's obsidian shell appears weathered and immense, while its coiling serpent companion boasts scales of profound darkness, accented by glacial blue-white and vermilion red details. Vibrant, dramatic colors rendered in thick, surrealist oil brushstrokes. Intricate details (shell plates, serpent scales, robe folds, ice crystals). Stark chiaroscuro lighting with dramatic soft illumination (e.g., moonlight piercing icy clouds). A full-body portrait in the powerful, narrative-driven style of James Jean, evoking ancient mystery and elemental winter power. --ar 9:16 --stylize 200 --v 7
